landing.logoAria: Go to top of TALKPIK home
landing.heroTitle: TOPIK writing, all the way through with AI
landing.heroBody: Set a study goal, work through problems, and narrow your weak spots with AI feedback. We recreate the TOPIK questions 51–54 writing environment exactly.

language.coverageNote: Your selected UI language takes effect once saved. Core screens (menus, buttons, this settings screen) switch immediately, and the remaining screen text is translated incrementally.
language.learningFieldLabel: Reference language for explanations, examples, and translation aids
language.learningFieldExtra: If unset, it follows the UI language. Some languages have no translation yet and may appear in the default language.
language.conflictDescription: Summary feedback and detailed explanations are an awkward combination. You can restore the recommended values.
language.helpUiScope: The UI language applies to interface text such as menus and buttons.
language.helpLearningScope: Learning language and content settings apply to feedback, examples, and explanations.
language.helpIncremental: Full translation of all screen text is rolled out incrementally.
language.unsupportedNotice: We currently support 한국어, English, and Tiếng Việt. Other languages are coming soon.
language.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved changes. Do you want to leave this page?
language.saveSuccess: Your language and content settings were saved.
